beatbox.build.no_qemu_img: {binary} is not installed, so BeatBox cannot create a disk. It is a separate package on most systems.
beatbox.build.source_not_a_disc: That is a disk, not an installer disc: {path}.
beatbox.build.no_target: No name for the disk to build.
beatbox.build.target_exists: There is already a disk at {path}. Choose another name.
beatbox.build.too_small: A disk needs at least 1 GB.

beatbox.machine.no_qemu: QEMU is not installed, so the machine tier is unavailable on this host.
beatbox.machine.no_image: No disk chosen. Choose one you already have.

beatbox.machine.too_few_cpus: Give it at least one CPU.
beatbox.machine.hostile_with_a_route_out: This machine is marked hostile, so it cannot be given a route to the internet. Use an isolated network, or unmark it.

beatbox.machine.could_not_start: The machine could not be turned on ({binary}): {detail}
beatbox.machine.ports_on_a_network: Ports cannot be forwarded into, or a debugger attached to, a machine cabled to a network sandbox. Reach it from another machine on that network.
beatbox.build.overlay_failed: The machine could not be given a disk of its own: {detail}
beatbox.machine.no_channel: BeatBox cannot reach the machine ({detail}). It may have been closed elsewhere.
beatbox.machine.channel_gone: BeatBox lost its connection to the inside of the machine: {detail}
beatbox.machine.channel_noise: The machine answered something BeatBox did not understand: {detail}
beatbox.machine.snapshot_failed: The save point {name} could not be made: {detail}
beatbox.machine.command_outlived_us: It is still going inside the machine. BeatBox stopped waiting for it, but did not stop it.
beatbox.tools.download_failed: The guest tools could not be downloaded: {detail}
beatbox.tools.wrong_file: The download was not the right file (SHA-256 {got}…, expected {expected}…), so it was deleted.
beatbox.tools.not_here: The guest tools have not been downloaded yet.
beatbox.sandbox.none: No sandboxes yet. Make one and it appears here, with everything it says.
beatbox.sandbox.can_nothing: This sandbox declared no capabilities, so there is nothing to ask it.
beatbox.sandbox.not_running: It has to be running before anything can be asked of it.
beatbox.sandbox.look_hint: Asks the guest what is true now. Nothing here refreshes on its own.
beatbox.sandbox.pick_one: Pick a sandbox on the right.
beatbox.sandbox.form.name: Name
beatbox.sandbox.form.disk_hint: A disk you already have. BeatBox never downloads one, and never writes to this file — the sandbox gets an overlay of its own.
beatbox.sandbox.form.agent: Talk to a guest agent inside
beatbox.sandbox.form.agent_hint: Running a command or reading a file needs qemu-guest-agent on the disk. Without it the sandbox still works, and simply does not offer those.
beatbox.machine.start_host_what: From a disk image or an installer disc
beatbox.machine.start_clone_linux: A copy of this computer · Linux only
beatbox.machine.disk_hint: A disk with an operating system already installed on it — BeatBox never downloads one, and never writes to this file: the machine gets a copy-on-write disk of its own, thrown away with it. Do not have one? Choose an installer disc (.iso) here, and it is installed for this machine.
beatbox.machine.disc_install: Install it on a disk of its own
beatbox.machine.disc_install_windows: Windows installs by itself, with nobody clicking anything, and then the machine starts: Windows asks its own questions there — region, keyboard, your account. The disk also stays in the list above, for more machines.
beatbox.machine.disc_install_disc: The installer opens in a window of its own. When it finishes and restarts, the machine starts from what it installed. The disk also stays in the list above, for more machines.
beatbox.machine.disc_live: Off: the machine boots the disc as it is, and keeps nothing it writes.
beatbox.machine.installing_windows: Windows installs by itself: 10 to 30 minutes.
beatbox.machine.installing_disc: Go through the installer in its own window.
beatbox.machine.installing_what: Then it starts and opens here.
beatbox.machine.memory_free: {free} GB free on this computer right now.
beatbox.machine.memory_too_much: Only {free} GB free right now — the system would stop it.
beatbox.machine.reach_inside_hint: Running commands and reading files inside the machine needs a small agent installed on its disk — qemu-guest-agent on Linux, the virtio-win guest tools on Windows. Without one the machine still works, and BeatBox simply will not offer those.
beatbox.display.unavailable: The machine display could not start: {detail}
beatbox.plain.is.destroyed: Thrown away. Its disk went with it.
beatbox.plain.boundary.none: It shares this computer — there is no boundary around it.
beatbox.plain.boundary.container: It has its own view of this computer, but shares its kernel.
beatbox.plain.boundary.machine: It has a kernel of its own, so nothing running in it is running on this computer.
beatbox.plain.reach.none: and no way to reach anything.
beatbox.plain.reach.isolated: and a network it cannot get out of.
beatbox.plain.reach.nat: and a way out to the internet.
beatbox.plain.sure.reset.what: Everything {name} has done since it was made goes, including its save points. The disk you gave it is not touched.
beatbox.plain.sure.destroy.what: {name} and its disk go for good. The disk you gave it is not touched.
beatbox.reach.isolated.what: A card, and nothing it sends gets out.
beatbox.reach.nat.what: A real way out. Not for anything you distrust.
beatbox.machine.bad_snapshot_name: A save point's name cannot have quotes or backslashes ({name}).
beatbox.plain.why.unknown: That did not work. The Engine screen says exactly why.
beatbox.plain.why.no_agent: Nothing inside is answering. Wait a minute; if it keeps saying this, install the guest agent on its disk.
beatbox.plain.why.no_disk: This machine has nothing to boot. Give it a disk you already have.
beatbox.plain.why.went_away: The machine went away on its own.
beatbox.plain.why.shut_down: It was shut down from inside. Start it again whenever you like.
beatbox.plain.why.out_of_memory: This computer ran out of memory and switched it off. Close something or give it less, then start it again.
beatbox.plain.why.not_enough_memory: It wants {wanted} GB and only {free} GB are free. Give it less, or close something first.
beatbox.plain.why.guest_lost: BeatBox lost this machine while it was closed. Start it again, or throw it away.
beatbox.plain.why.tools_download_failed: The guest tools did not download. Check you are online and try again.
beatbox.plain.why.tools_wrong_file: The download was not the right file, so it was thrown away. Try again later.
beatbox.plain.why.tools_not_here: The guest tools are not on this computer yet.
beatbox.plain.why.gone: This machine has been thrown away.
beatbox.plain.why.not_now: Not while the machine is like this.
beatbox.plain.why.no_save_point: There is no save point by that name.
beatbox.plain.why.no_file: There is no such file inside the machine.
beatbox.plain.why.blank: Something that had to be filled in was left blank.
beatbox.plain.why.no_room: There is not enough left on this computer for a machine that size.
beatbox.plain.why.unknown_kind: BeatBox does not know how to make that kind of machine.
beatbox.plain.why.broke: Something went wrong underneath. The Engine screen has the detail.
beatbox.plain.why.no_disk_there: The disk is not there: {path}. Reconnect the drive, then try again.
beatbox.machine.disk_missing.title: Source disk unavailable
beatbox.machine.disk_missing.help: Its disk is not there. Reconnect the drive, then check again.
beatbox.machine.disk_missing.location: Mount the drive at the same place as before.
beatbox.plain.why.no_qemu: QEMU is not installed, so no machine can run. Install it in Setup.
beatbox.plain.why.too_little_memory: That is not enough memory to boot anything.
beatbox.plain.why.too_few_cpus: A machine needs at least one processor.
beatbox.plain.why.hostile_with_a_way_out: Something marked as dangerous cannot be given a way out to the internet.
beatbox.plain.why.save_failed: The save point could not be taken: {detail}
beatbox.plain.why.bad_save_name: A save point cannot be called that. Leave out quotes and backslashes.
beatbox.plain.why.still_going: It is still running inside. Nothing was stopped.
beatbox.plain.why.no_disk_made: BeatBox could not give this machine a disk of its own.
beatbox.plain.why.unreadable_disk: That file cannot be read as a disk.
beatbox.plain.why.disk_in_the_way: There is already something where this machine's disk would go.

beatbox.beatdrop.title: Clone this computer
beatbox.beatdrop.step_where: Step 2 of 2 · Where to keep it
beatbox.beatdrop.kind_system: this system, copied while it runs
beatbox.beatdrop.kind_idle: not in use, copied byte for byte
beatbox.beatdrop.space: The copy takes about {need} GB of {free} GB free.
beatbox.beatdrop.copying_hint: This takes a while. You can close this window; the copy keeps going.
beatbox.beatdrop.what: Make a full copy of a physical disk: boot, apps, accounts and files. You choose CPU, memory and network next; the network starts off.
beatbox.beatdrop.selected_in_use: This is the system disk in use. It is copied while it runs: its partitions are rebuilt in a new image and filled file by file, twice, to catch what changes. Close programs with open databases for the cleanest copy.
beatbox.beatdrop.cannot_live: This disk is in use ({why}). Eject it in the file manager, then open this again.
beatbox.beatdrop.mounted_other: This disk has mounted volumes, so it is copied live like the system disk. To copy it byte for byte instead, unmount it and open this again.
beatbox.beatdrop.needed: The copy needs about {size} GB. It goes into a BeatDrop folder there.
beatbox.beatdrop.no_target: No disk to keep the copy on. Connect a USB disk and open this again.
beatbox.beatdrop.leave_out_pick: Choose a folder to leave out
beatbox.beatdrop.leave_out_what: Folders left out stay in the copy, empty.
beatbox.beatdrop.measuring_home: Measuring the folders in your home folder…
beatbox.beatdrop.same_disk: This is on the disk being copied. The copy leaves its own BeatDrop folder out.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.leave_out_bad: That is not a folder on this disk that can be left out.
beatbox.beatdrop.selected_dependent: This disk belongs to a set. BeatDrop needs to include the other disks before it can clone it.
beatbox.beatdrop.offline: If your system disk is in use, boot another system or external media and open BeatBox there.
beatbox.beatdrop.name: Copy name
beatbox.beatdrop.private: The copy includes personal files and saved passwords, and asks for administrator authorization.
beatbox.beatdrop.none: No physical disk is available to clone.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.platform: Disk capture is available on Linux hosts.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.inspect_failed: Could not inspect the disks on this computer.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.source_missing: Choose a physical disk from the list.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.mounted: This disk has mounted volumes. Boot another system to clone it.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.dependent_error: This disk depends on other disks that this capture cannot include yet.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.size_unknown: Could not read the disk size.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.partial: An unfinished capture with this name needs attention.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.target_missing: Choose where to keep the copy.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.exists: A disk with this name already exists.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.bad_name: Use up to 64 characters and start the name with a letter or number.
beatbox.beatdrop.error.busy: A disk operation is already running.
beatbox.install.size_hint: It only takes up what is written to it.

beatbox.disk.unknown: There is no disk called {name} any more.
beatbox.plain.why.disk_in_use: A machine is still using that disk. Throw the machine away first.
beatbox.plain.why.no_such_disk: That disk is not there any more.
beatbox.plain.why.fixed_setting: That cannot change on a machine that already exists. Make a new one instead.

beatbox.machine.settings_locked: Stop the machine to change these.
beatbox.machine.settings_saved: Saved. It starts with these next time.
beatbox.machine.capture_hint: Keeps a copy of everything the machine sends and receives, seen from outside it, so you can see who it tried to talk to. It starts with the next start, and each start replaces the last recording.

beatbox.traffic.what: Recorded from outside the machine, so nothing running inside it can hide it.
beatbox.traffic.off: Not recording. Turn it on in Settings.
beatbox.traffic.waiting: Recording starts the next time the machine starts.
beatbox.traffic.quiet: It has not tried to talk to anything outside this computer yet.
beatbox.traffic.contained: None of this got out: only attempts.
beatbox.traffic.open: On the internet: this may have got through.

beatbox.disks.unreadable: This does not read as a disk: {detail}
beatbox.disks.virtualbox_difference: This is one of VirtualBox's snapshot files, not a whole disk. Choose the machine's main disk instead — or, to keep the latest state, clone the machine in VirtualBox (Clone → Current state) and choose the new disk.
beatbox.disks.ova_compressed: The disk in this .ova is compressed, which BeatBox cannot read yet. Export the machine again from VirtualBox without compression, or unpack the .ova yourself.
beatbox.disks.ova_without_disk: There is no disk inside this .ova.
beatbox.disks.unpack_failed: The disk could not be taken out: {detail}

beatbox.machine.foreign: A {maker} disk: used as it is, never changed and never copied.
beatbox.machine.virtualbox_snapshots: This disk is the machine before its VirtualBox snapshots. For the latest state, clone it in VirtualBox (Clone → Current state).
beatbox.machine.uefi_found: Installed for UEFI: BeatBox will start it that way.
beatbox.machine.firmware.bios.what: The classic PC start. Older systems.
beatbox.machine.firmware.uefi.what: The modern start. Windows 11 and most recent systems.
beatbox.plain.why.not_a_disk: This does not read as a disk: {detail}
beatbox.plain.why.virtualbox_difference: This is a VirtualBox snapshot file. Choose the machine's main disk, or clone it in VirtualBox (Clone → Current state).

beatbox.plain.why.ova_without_disk: There is no disk inside this .ova.
beatbox.plain.why.unpack_failed: The disk could not be taken out: {detail}

beatbox.disks.nothing_installed: Nothing was installed: it closed before the installer wrote anything. Make it again and choose “Install” inside.
beatbox.disks.install_unfinished: The installer wrote to the disk but left nothing it can start from — the install did not finish. The disk was kept, but a machine made from it will not start.
beatbox.disks.install_killed: The installer was stopped from outside before it finished — most often because this computer ran out of memory. Its half-made disk was thrown away: close something else, and try again.
beatbox.machine.not_bootable: Nothing on this disk can start. Install onto it again, or choose another disk.
beatbox.machine.cannot_start: Nothing on its disk can start: it is empty, or the install did not finish. Make a new machine from the installer (.iso).
beatbox.plain.why.nothing_installed: Nothing was installed: it closed before the installer wrote anything. Make it again and choose “Install” inside.
beatbox.plain.why.install_unfinished: The install did not finish, so nothing on the disk can start. Install again.
beatbox.reach.network.what: A cable to one of your networks, and nothing past it.
beatbox.plain.reach.network: and a cable to a BeatBox network, as {address}.
beatbox.machine.fact.reach.isolated: Its own network, no way out

beatbox.machine.snapshot_delete_failed: The save point {name} could not be deleted: {detail}

beatbox.plain.why.setup_differs: {name} was saved when {setting} was {was}; now it is {now}. Stop the machine, set it back, then go back.

beatbox.plain.why.state_saved: State saved: it carries on from here.

beatbox.machine.saved_state_lost: Its saved state could not be used, so it started from scratch. Its disk is fine.
beatbox.machine.stage.running: {name} is open in its own window.
beatbox.machine.stage.paused: Frozen. Everything inside is held exactly where it was.
